request.prompt:
Create a silent full-body character animation asset for the Læria children's learning app from the supplied locked Storesøster original. The supplied first and last images are the same original: match both exactly in design, framing and neutral pose. Keep the same face, green-brown eyes, brown wavy hair, purple flower headband, pointed ears, purple and green leaf dress, brown cross-body bag, knitted socks and detailed brown flower boots. One character only. Keep the camera perfectly locked: no zoom, pan, crop, cuts, rotation, scale change or reframing. Keep both feet firmly planted at the original positions and the whole head, hands and boots within the frame. Maintain the original lighting and simple background throughout. Do not add props, scenery, particles, text, speech, singing, music or sound. Preserve hand and finger anatomy; the other hand and bag remain in the original position. The movement must be gentle and readable at small app size. Begin in the exact supplied neutral hand-on-hip pose, perform just the specified action, and finish in the same neutral pose.
ACTION — CALM IDLE, 6 seconds: a relaxed slow breath visible only subtly through shoulders and chest, one natural soft blink, and an almost imperceptible friendly head inclination. Both hands remain in their original poses throughout. No waving, talking or bobbing up and down. Smooth continuous motion with matched calm first and last frames, suitable for a seamless repeating idle loop. Return completely to the original neutral expression and posture by the final second.

rejection_reasons: Provider watermark overlaps the feet/ground region.
Unrequested animated blue lines and black background; idle is not a clean neutral loop ready for the app.
